Airline Food.description: Found by breaking open regular and large luggages

Aloe Vera.description: Found in the Mesa; using it reduces Heat.

AMULET_CLONE.description: On use, duplicate an item. Duplicated items will have the same number of uses available as the original item. Amulets and checkpoint flags cannot be duplicated

AMULET_DOUBLEJUMP.description: Using it briefly grants nearby scouts Slow Fall, followed by Wind Walk for low-gravity movement.

AMULET_HEALING.description: Using it heals several negative statuses and grants temporary invulnerability.

AMULET_INFINITESTAM.description: Using it creates a temporary yellow bubble that grants infinite stamina to the user and other scouts inside.

Ancient Idol.description: Found in the Mesa Tomb after completing its challenge. Holding it grants invincibility and prevents Bonus stamina use; picking it up grants Esoterica. Throwing it into lava in the Kiln or Citadel unlocks 24 Karat.

anti-rope cannon.description: Attaches a 7.25 metre anti-rope which spools upwards. It has zero weight and will float when dropped. Incinerating this item makes it unusable.

anti-rope spool.description: Provides a total of 12.5 metres climbable anti gravity rope, placeable in custom lengths from 0.75m to 10m long. The rope will float upwards. It has negative weight and will float when dropped. Incinerating this item makes it unusable.

Antidote.description: Up to three uses. Throwing shatters it and removes Poison and Spores from nearby players. After cooking, using it releases a small antidote cloud without knockback.

AUTOPARACHUTE.description: Unused content: a blue, one-use parachute that deploys automatically during a fall to prevent fall damage.

Backpack.description: Occupies the fourth inventory slot and provides four additional storage slots. Cooking changes its appearance only; it can still store items after repeated incineration.

Balloon.description: Attaches a balloon that reduces gravity; multiple balloons can lift the player upward. Balloons pop after a limited time or ascent, and fly away when dropped. Cooking pops the balloon and makes it unusable.

Balloon Bunch.description: Attaches a bunch of balloons that reduces gravity. It pops after a limited time or ascent and flies away when dropped. Cooking pops the balloons and makes them unusable.

Bandages.description: Single-use. Heals injury on the user. Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.

Beehive.description: Found in trees in the tropics. Breaking it open drops four Honeycombs and releases the bees inside. The cooking stage transfers to the Honeycombs inside when the hive breaks.

Berrynana Peel.description: Dropped after eating a Berrynana; stepping on it makes scouts slip and briefly fall.

Big Egg.description: Found in nests on rocks in the Caldera. Cracking it usually yields an Egg and occasionally a pre-cooked Bird. The Egg inherits the Big Egg's cooking stage; the bird result has an exception and cannot be inferred directly from that stage.

Big Lollipop.description: Found in luggage. Grants infinite stamina while being eaten; when uncooked, the effect is followed by Drowsy. The cooked or well-done stage removes this Drowsy penalty.

Bing Bong.description: BING BONG! Cooking lowers the pitch and volume of its voice lines; incineration silences it.

Binoculars.description: Held to zoom in and view distant terrain

Bird.description: A rare result from cracking Big Eggs or Small Eggs, normally spawning already cooked. Cooking it to well-done does not improve its effects. Burning reduces Hunger restoration and removes Bonus Stamina; further incineration adds Poison.

Blowgun.description: Fires darts at other scouts; it does not spawn in solo play. Uncooked darts apply Drowsy; cooking changes that effect to Heat.

Blue Berrynana.description: Found in the tropics. Drops a Berrynana Peel when eaten

Blue Shroomberry.description: Found in the Roots. Eating it raw releases Spores and may cause a random harmful effect. The cooked or well-done stage removes its original Spores; this does not establish that every harmful effect is removed.

Bounce Fungus.description: Found in the roots. Creates a bouncy platform when thrown at a surface

Brown Berrynana.description: Found in the tropics. Drops a Berrynana Peel when eaten

Bugle.description: Found at the photobooth and crash site. Plays a musical note when used. Each cooking makes its pitch wobble more.

Bugle of Friendship.description: Grants nearby scouts infinite stamina while played; it can only be played for a limited time.

Bugle Shroom.description: Found in the Shore, Tropics, Roots, and Mesa; some varieties are poisonous. Cooking does not remove Poison from poisonous mushroom varieties.

Button Shroom.description: Found in the Shore, Tropics, Roots, and Mesa; some varieties are poisonous. Cooking does not remove Poison from poisonous mushroom varieties.

Cactus.description: Found in the mesa. Afflicts thorns onto the user

Candlestick.description: Found in the gloom and the Citadel. Provides a source of light

Chain Launcher.description: Creates a climbable chain between two points. Incinerating this item makes it unusable.

Checkpoint Flag.description: Places a single-use respawn checkpoint for the scout who placed it. Only explosives can cook this flag, and each explosion advances its cooking stage by two. Cooking adds a Bonus stamina effect when it is used.

Chubby Shroom.description: Found on the shore, tropics and roots

Climbing Chalk.description: Unused content with no model or texture; the Wiki documents a temporary reduction in climbing stamina use.

Cloud Fungus.description: Found in the roots. Creates a platform when thrown at a wall

Cluster Shroom.description: Found in the Shore, Tropics, Roots, and Mesa; some varieties are poisonous. Cooking does not remove Poison from poisonous mushroom varieties.

Coconut.description: Found on the shore, tropics and mesa. Breaking it yields two Coconut Halves. Cooking it produces cooked Half-Coconuts.

Coconut Half.description: Obtained by splitting a Coconut; eating it reduces Heat. The cooked or well-done stage improves Hunger restoration and provides Bonus Stamina.

Compass.description: Found at the shore crash site. Points towards the PEAK

Conch.description: Found on the shore. Can be thrown, but serves little other purpose

Cure-All.description: On use, removes nearly every negative status effect from the user. When used after cooking, it explodes into a small healing cloud without knockback.

Cursed Skull.description: On use, instantly kills the scout holding it and grants bonus stamina to other players. Cooking activates it immediately, then triggers a dynamite-like explosion.

Dynamite.description: Found on the ground and in luggage in the mesa. Detonates after a short fuse, afflicting injury to nearby scouts. Cooking makes it explode immediately.

EARLYWORM.description: Found on the ground in the Gloom; eating it clears Drowsy and grants the Well Rested badge. Cooking stops it moving but adds no Bonus Stamina. Burning reduces Hunger restoration; further incineration increases Poison when eaten.

Egg.description: Found in the caldera and gloom, or produced by breaking a Big Egg

Energy Drink.description: Found in luggage; drinking it temporarily boosts movement speed. When uncooked, Drowsy follows the boost. At the cooked or well-done stage, drinking it causes an explosion that knocks back nearby players, extends the speed boost, and adds no new Drowsy afterward.

Faerie Lantern.description: When uncooked, using it gradually removes several negative statuses from the user. After cooking, using it causes an explosion and releases a small healing cloud.

Fannypack.description: Worn to provide additional storage slots

First Aid Kit.description: Takes 5 seconds to use. Removes poison and spores, and heals injury. Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.

Flare.description: Found at the crash site and peak. Summons the rescue helicopter when used at the PEAK. Cooking makes it explode, injuring scouts in a small radius.

Fortified Milk.description: Found in luggage; drinking it reduces Heat and grants temporary invulnerability. The first cooking stage extends the invulnerability duration; further cooking does not extend it again.

Frisbee.description: Thrown through the air, and can bonk other scouts

Frog.description: Found in the gloom. Can be picked up and carried. Cooking transforms it into Frog Legs.

FrogLegs.description: Obtained by cooking a Frog. It spawns already cooked in normal play; raw Frog Legs are not normally obtainable. The cooked or well-done stage restores Hunger and provides Bonus Stamina.

Glider.description: Held while falling to glide slowly and steer through the air

Gold Prickleberry.description: Found in the Mesa. Eating it raw reduces Heat and heals Injury but applies Thorns; whether cooking removes Thorns remains unverified.

Green Clusterberry.description: Unused item. The Wiki reports Hunger restoration and Poison removal; cooking behavior is undocumented.

Green Crispberry.description: Found mainly on bushes in the Shore and Tropics, occasionally elsewhere. Eating it raw causes delayed Poison. Cooked and well-done stages remove its original Poison and have the same effects. Burning reduces Hunger restoration and removes Bonus Stamina; further incineration increases Poison.

Green Kingberry.description: Found on trees in the Tropics. Eating it raw causes immediate Poison; the cooked or well-done stage removes its original Poison.

Green Shroomberry.description: Found in the Roots. Eating it raw releases Spores and may cause a random harmful effect. The cooked or well-done stage removes its original Spores; this does not establish that every harmful effect is removed.

Guidebook.description: Found at the shore crash site. Teaches basic gameplay. Incinerating this item makes it unusable.

Heat Pack.description: Found in the alpine. Removes cold from the user. Cooking makes it explode, injuring scouts in a small radius.

Honeycomb.description: Obtained by breaking a Beehive in the tropics and roots

Hot Dog.description: Found at campfires or disguised as a cattail in the Gloom.

Jetpack.description: Worn to propel the scout upwards while its fuel lasts

Lantern.description: Found in the tropics and alpine. Provides light and removes cold. Cooking makes it explode, injuring scouts in a small radius.

Magic Bean.description: Grows a climbable vine up to 10 metres tall roughly 3 seconds after being planted, if unobstructed

Mandrake.description: Found in the Roots; it screams when uprooted. Eating it raw temporarily hides the Stamina bar. Cooking stops the scream, and eating it cooked removes Curse.

Medicinal Root.description: Found in the Shore, Tropics, Roots, and Mesa; using it removes Poison and Spores and heals Injury. Cooking removes additional Poison and Spores.

Megaphone.description: Unused content; the Wiki presents voice-range amplification as a possibility, not a confirmed effect.

Napberry.description: Found in Alpine caves. Eating it clears most status effects except Curse and Petrify, but causes severe Drowsiness and temporarily knocks the user out.

Orange Winterberry.description: Found in the alpine. Removes heat from the user

Pandora's Lunchbox.description: Up to three uses. When uncooked, each use randomizes the user's status effects. Using it after cooking causes an explosion and applies random effects to nearby players without knockback.

Parasol.description: Protects the scout from the mesa's sunlight, and slows a fall when held

Pink Berrynana.description: Found on vines in the tropics. Eating it drops a Berrynana Peel; eating it raw causes Poison, while the cooked or well-done stage removes its original Poison effect.

Pirate's Compass.description: Points to the nearest unopened luggage or unused Ancient Statue

Piton.description: Attaches to a climbable surface, providing a point for scouts to grab and rest. Incinerating this item makes it unusable.

Portable Stove.description: Placed to cook items. Lasts 60 seconds after being placed. Cooking makes it explode, injuring scouts in a small radius.

Purple Shroomberry.description: Found in the Roots. Eating it raw releases Spores and may cause a random beneficial or harmful effect. The cooked or well-done stage removes its original Spores; this does not establish that random effects are removed.

Red Clusterberry.description: Found in the tropics. Heals injury on the user

Red Crispberry.description: Found on bushes across several biomes. The cooked or well-done stage improves Hunger restoration and provides Bonus Stamina.

Red Prickleberry.description: Found on cacti in the Mesa. Eating it reduces Heat. Eating it raw also applies Thorns; the cooked or well-done stage removes its original Thorns.

Red Shroomberry.description: Found in the Roots. Eating it raw releases Spores and may cause a random beneficial effect. The cooked or well-done stage removes its original Spores.

Remedy Fungus.description: Releases a cloud of healing smoke with an 8 metre radius when dropped

Rescue Claw.description: Can be used 3 times. Pulls the wielder toward terrain, or pulls other scouts toward them. Incinerating this item makes it unusable.

RitualDagger.description: Found in Ancient Luggage or Ancient Statues in co-op. Use it from behind on another Scout to sacrifice them, heal yourself of most negative effects, and gain Bonus stamina; it does not remove Thorns, Curse, or Petrify.

Rocketpack.description: Worn to launch the scout upwards in a single burst

rope cannon.description: Fires a harpoon that drops a climbable rope where it strikes a compatible surface. Incinerating this item makes it unusable.

rope spool.description: Deploys climbable rope up to 10 metres long, attachable to any climbable surface. Incinerating this item makes it unusable.

Scorchberry.description: Found in the tropics, roots and alpine. Afflicts heat onto the user

Scorpion.description: Found in Mesa canyons and cliffs; it can be held but not stored, and it cannot be eaten raw. Cooking makes it edible and stops it moving or attacking; it still cannot be stored in an inventory slot or Backpack.

Scout Cannon.description: Places a cannon that launches scouts across the map. Afflicts injury on launch. Cooking makes it explode in a manner similar to Dynamite.

Scout Effigy.description: A one-use mystical item that can revive a dead or unconscious Scout at the target location; it does not spawn in solo play. Cooking grants Bonus stamina when the effigy is used. Using it after Incineration also inflicts Poison on the user.

Scoutmaster's Bugle.description: A single-use mystical item found in Ancient Luggage or at Ancient Statues; blowing it grants Bonus Stamina to the user and nearby scouts and summons the Scoutmaster for two minutes. Playing it after Incineration also inflicts Poison on the user.

SCOUTMASTERSOUL.description: Freed in Nadir, the Scoutmaster's soul follows the Scout to the Peak and reunites with Myres in the ending.

ScoutsHonor.description: Created when four Scout Amulets are bestowed on the Stone Scout at the Peak; activating it sends all Scouts to Nadir. Cooking triggers a 40-meter Anti-Sphere explosion and summons the Scoutmaster to chase the player who cooked it.

Scroll.description: Found at campfires. Opens to reveal a Torn Page. Cooking adds a Bonus stamina effect when the scroll is opened.

Shelf Fungus.description: Creates a platform when thrown at a wall

Skull.description: Unused plain version of Cursed Skull; it has no gameplay effect and may make creepy noises nearby.

Small Egg.description: Found in Raven nests in the Gloom. Cracking it usually yields an Egg and rarely a Cooked Bird. Cooking the Small Egg also cooks the Egg it yields when cracked; the rare Cooked Bird result is separate.

SNOWBALL.description: Picked up from snow piles in the Alpine and throwable at other scouts; larger snowballs cause stronger knockback, and become too large to pick up beyond a certain size. A cooked Snowball inflicts Cold when it hits but does not knock the target down.

Sports Drink.description: Found in luggage; drinking it removes a large amount of Heat. The first cooking stage adds Bonus Stamina, with no further increase from continued cooking. Burning or incineration adds no penalty.

Stick.description: Unused wood prop; the Wiki says it may have been intended as campfire fuel, but documents no working use.

Stone.description: Unused stone; the Wiki notes campfire-heating code intended to prevent Cold, but says it does not appear to work.

Strange Gem.description: Found in the Stone Scout's hands at the Peak; clicking it toggles its activation message. Cooking grants Bonus Stamina when it is bestowed on the statue; bestowing it after incineration also applies Poison. Placing four Scout Amulets in the statue's slots transforms it into Scout's Honor.

Sunscreen.description: Up to three uses. Uncooked spray grants temporary Sun Protection. Using it after cooking causes an explosion and releases a large sunscreen cloud without knockback.

THEBOOKOFBONES.description: On use, afflicts curse onto the holder. Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.

Tick.description: Found in the tropics. Does not afflict poison when eaten

Torch.description: Found only inside the mesa's Tomb. Provides light for a limited time

Torn Page.description: A page from Scoutmaster Myres's diary, revealed by opening a Scroll according to the player's reading progress and campfire location.

VOIDLAUNCHER.description: Found in ancient luggage and statues. Shoots an anti-sphere up to 40 metres away that reverses gravity where it lands. Cooking makes it explode and creates a larger Anti-Sphere at its location.

WARP COMPASS.description: Teleports the user to a random scout. No longer obtainable in normal play after bugs sent players off the map

Warp Compass.description: Teleports the user to a random scout. No longer obtainable in normal play after bugs sent players off the map

Warp Fungus.description: When thrown, teleports the user to where it lands

Warpsketball.description: Unused basketball variant that teleports players to where it lands and is consumed on use.

Weird Shroom.description: Unused non-poisonous mushroom that can be eaten twice; its intended glowing effect does not work.

Yellow Berrynana.description: Found in the tropics. Drops a Berrynana Peel when eaten

Yellow Kingberry.description: Found on trees in the Tropics. Eating it raw causes delayed Poison; the cooked or well-done stage removes its original Poison.

Yellow Shroomberry.description: Found in the Roots. Eating it raw releases Spores and may cause a random beneficial effect. The cooked or well-done stage removes its original Spores.

Yellow Winterberry.description: Found in the alpine. Removes heat and heals injury
